notes: Different format from all prior papers (2016-a/b/c): 'SCB - SCIENCE' cover, Sl. Code 204, 50 questions, Full Marks 90, bilingual line-by-line (Hindi then English for every question, not just instructions).

Group A (60 marks) is split into 3 per-subject blocks (Physics/Chemistry/Biology), EACH restarting its own Q1-Q10 numbering — not one running Q1-30 like the 2016 series. Same restart pattern in Group B (Physics Q1-7, Chemistry Q1-7, Biology Q1-6 = 20 MCQ).

Two 5-mark questions in Group A have an OR ('अथवा') alternative that itself requires a hand-drawn diagram (Biology Q10-OR: flower L.S.). These will be diagram.required:true and excluded from usableInQuiz at Stage D, same as the 2016-b nephron/brain case.

Chemistry Q10 (Group A) is a match-the-column question (5 columns each side) — a question type not seen in the 2016 series. Recorded as printed; Stage E will need to determine correct pairing since column order is intentionally scrambled (that's the question itself).

Page 6 (Biology Q8) has an inline watermark 'http://www.bsebstudy.com' printed within the question text — confirms this is a downloaded guide-book copy, consistent with prior papers' F3 finding (not board-issued).
No printed answer key anywhere in this 12-page paper (confirmed page 1-12) — unlike 2016-b/c which had printed keys. Stage E will need the textbook/RAG route for this paper, same as pilot 2016-a.

Handwritten pencil tick/slash marks next to several question numbers throughout (e.g. Q1, Q3-5, Q8-10 on various pages) — look like a student's own annotation of which questions they answered, not an answer key. Recorded as observed only, per Stage B rule.
